pbr.title: Policy routing
pbr.intro: Policy-based routing (VPP ABF): packets permitted by a policy's ACL are forwarded over its paths instead of the routing table. Attach a policy to the interface the packets arrive on.
pbr.pending: The candidate changes policy routing: commit it with the pending-change bar.
pbr.noAcl: No access list exists yet: a policy matches packets with an ACL of Firewall › ACL.
pbr.noCounters: ACL hit counters per policy are not available in this release.

adl.title: ADL / Auto-SDL
adl.intro: Anti-spoofing per interface: uRPF checks that a packet's source is routable (loose) or routable back through the receiving interface (strict); the allow/deny list (ADL) drops packets whose source is not in the allow-list VRF.
adl.note: The same settings are in the interface drawer (Interfaces › interface › Security). The allow-list binding cannot be read back from VPP: Retrieve shows only whether ADL is on.
adl.physicalOnly: ADL works on physical ports (DPDK) only; the allow-list VRF must hold the allowed source prefixes as local entries. Non-IP frames always pass.

autoSdl.title: Auto-SDL
autoSdl.globals: Automatic source deny list of VPP's host stack (TCP towards the router itself). It is a VPP-global setting: only the agent that owns the globals applies it, and it needs the session layer's SDL backend.

name.title: Name
name.help: letters, digits, _, . and -; at most 63 characters
name.invalid: letters, digits, _, . and - only (no #), at most 63

acl.title: ACL
acl.help: the access list whose permitted packets this policy forwards

priority.title: Priority
priority.help: order among the policies attached to one interface (lower first)

paths.title: Paths
paths.help: where matching packets go; weighted when more than one

address.title: Next-hop address
address.help: the gateway matching packets are sent to; empty for an interface or VRF path

interface.title: Egress interface
interface.help: send out of this interface; empty for a next hop resolved in the lookup VRF

vrf.title: Lookup VRF
vrf.help: the VRF the next hop is resolved in, or — without address and interface — the VRF the packet is looked up in

family.title: Address family
family.help: the policy acts on packets of this address family

urpf.title: Unicast RPF
urpf.help: reverse-path check of the source address; no mode = off

ipv4.title: IPv4 check
ipv4.help: loose: the source must be routable; strict: routable through this interface

ipv6.title: IPv6 check
ipv6.help: loose: the source must be routable; strict: routable through this interface

direction.title: Direction
direction.help: rx checks packets received on the interface, tx packets sent out of it

adl.title: Allow/deny list (ADL)
adl.help: off unless IPv4 or IPv6 sources are checked

ipv4.title: Check IPv4 sources
ipv4.help: drop IPv4 packets whose source is not in the allow-list VRF

ipv6.title: Check IPv6 sources
ipv6.help: drop IPv6 packets whose source is not in the allow-list VRF

allowVrf.title: Allow-list VRF
allowVrf.help: VRF whose table holds the allowed sources as local entries

defaultAllow.title: Pass non-IP frames
defaultAllow.help: VPP 26.06 cannot filter non-IP frames: keep it on

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.help: deny new host-stack TCP sessions from a source that exceeds the threshold

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.help: hits from one source before its deny entry is created

removeTimeoutSec.title: Remove timeout (s)
removeTimeoutSec.help: lifetime of an automatic deny entry

urpf.title: Unicast RPF
urpf.help: reverse-path check of the source address; absent = off

adl.title: Allow/deny list (ADL)
adl.help: source allow-list on physical ports; off unless IPv4 or IPv6 is checked
